exposure: Glycated haemoglobin (HbA1c) levels at GDM diagnosis
finding: Higher HbA1c levels at GDM diagnosis were significantly associated with an increased risk of macrosomia, cesarean delivery, and preterm delivery.
mod_finding: HbA1c ≥ 5.6% (38 mmol/mol) was associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery.
